fields.title: How a jacket image reaches a page

sections.What this covers: The request path, the writers that fill the image container, and what a borrower sees when a leg of the path fails. The routes, the cache key and the container itself belong to the service records. Where the rest of the estate sits belongs to [exp-estate-overview](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/explanations/estate-overview.md).
sections.Where the detail lives:
* [svc-covers-cdn](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/services/covers-cdn.md) describes the edge, its routes and its cache key.
* [svc-thumbnailer](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/services/thumbnailer.md) describes the origin and the container it reads.
* [svc-catalogue-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/services/catalogue-api.md) describes the gateway that writes staff uploads.
* [itg-bibliographic-data](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/integrations/bibliographic-data.md) describes the supplier the nightly import takes its imagery from.
* [ofr-discovery](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/offerings/discovery.md) lists what a borrower uses to find a title, and states that a title with no image shows a placeholder.
* [exp-estate-overview](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/5366f89b36406e8d238c777f2e4cf7cc245e4492/examples/library/explanations/estate-overview.md) puts this path beside the rest of the estate.
